Legacy company.domain backfill is normalized and explicitly unverified at confidence 0.45; legacy source values are preserved.

Identity matching uses verified aliases/domains, normalized employer name and ATS tenant; unverified legacy domain values do not establish official identity.
Official-domain candidate resolver ranks allowlisted evidence and preserves equal-rank disagreement as ambiguous; known aggregator domains and source categories are excluded.

The Company Discover fixture workflow persists observed domains as unverified candidates and no longer writes them into the legacy official-domain field.
